name: those you call monsters
source:
You wake up in an unfamiliar forest. You don't remember how you got there, or why. You're all alone, until you stumble upon a strange creature.

[From [url=https://decadencethief.itch.io/those-you-call-monsters]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一片陌生的森林中醒来，记不清自己为何会来到这里，又是怎么来的。你孤身一人，直到偶然遇见了一只奇异的生物。

[摘自[url=https://decadencethief.itch.io/those-you-call-monsters]Itch.io[/url]]
